service.description: Sales order totals by interval from the sales search index, for the organizations named (vendorPartyIds or fromPartyIds), else every organization the user works in. Refuses a user without report read (ACCOUNTING_VIEW) and an organization the user may not read (F6). A holder of COMMERCE_VIEW without report read is answered for productStoreIds all in their store scope, as the stores' organizations, costs withheld without PRODUCT_COST_VIEW (Commerce P11, F21); ACCOUNTING_VIEW's answers are unchanged. A holder of SALES_REPORT_VIEW without report read is answered for the organizations of their sales scope (an organization named must be one of them), costs withheld without PRODUCT_COST_VIEW (Sales P1, F2).

parameter.name: currencyUomIds
parameter.description: Only these currencies (Commerce P11: a store-scoped read never sums across currencies); empty, every one as before

service.description: An organization's sales between two days or in one of its fiscal periods, by product, customer or customer class (groupBy), each row with what was ordered (its sales orders placed), issued from those orders, invoiced (its issued sales invoices, by book day) and returned, with quantities and values in the document's currency, largest invoiced value first. Only sales lines count (the ItemSales types), not tax, shipping or adjustments; returns once requested; credit memos no return made are not counted. Without a period or days, the organization's fiscal month holding today. Every read is the organization's own, so its top products and customer classes hold no other organization's sales (F6). A read over 2,000 documents of a kind is named (complete false). Refuses a user without report read in the organization, a period of another organization and a unit that is not a currency.
